result.instructions: Tools for Clearstream, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our lists has the most subscribers, and how many are active for texting?"; "Show the text volume for last month, incoming and outgoing."; "Add the new volunteer at +12005551234 to the Volunteers list.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Clearstream data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run clearstream_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run clearstream_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run clearstream_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. clearstream_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: clearstream_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Clearstream account behind the API key: name, plan and settings. Good first call to confirm which account is connected. Clearstream API: GET /v1/account.

tools.name: clearstream_list_numbers
tools.title: List sending numbers
tools.description: List the shortcodes and longcodes this account can send texts from, and which one is the default. Clearstream API: GET /v1/numbers.

tools.name: clearstream_list_lists
tools.title: List lists
tools.description: List the subscriber lists (groups) in the account, with subscriber counts. Filter by name or locked state. Clearstream API: GET /v1/lists.

name.description: Partial match on the list name.

tools.name: clearstream_get_list
tools.title: Get a list
tools.description: Get one subscriber list: name, subscriber count, active texting subscriber count and sync status. Clearstream API: GET /v1/lists/{id}.

tools.name: clearstream_list_subscribers_of_list
tools.title: List subscribers in a list
tools.description: List the subscribers in one list, with optional name filters. Clearstream API: GET /v1/lists/{id}/subscribers.

full_name.description: Partial match on the full name.

first.description: Partial match on the first name.

tools.name: clearstream_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: Search the account's subscribers by name or mobile number. Clearstream API: GET /v1/subscribers.

full_name.description: Partial match on the full name.

first.description: Partial match on the first name.

last.description: Partial match on the last name.

mobile_number.description: Exact match on the mobile number.

tools.name: clearstream_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get a subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber by mobile number: name, opt-in status, lists and tags. Clearstream API: GET /v1/subscribers/{number}.

mobile_number.description: Mobile number in E.164 format, for example +12005551000.

tools.name: clearstream_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the subscriber tags in the account. Clearstream API: GET /v1/tags.

tools.name: clearstream_list_texts
tools.title: List texts
tools.description: List texts in the account's inbox history, incoming or outgoing, optionally for one number. Use the cursor from a previous reply for the next page. Clearstream API: GET /v1/texts.

direction.description: IN for incoming, OUT for outgoing.

mobile_number.description: Exact match on the contact's mobile number.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous reply.

tools.name: clearstream_get_text_stats
tools.title: Get text statistics
tools.description: Get text volume statistics for a date range (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Clearstream API: GET /v1/stats/texts.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the statistics (default UTC).

tools.name: clearstream_send_text
tools.title: Send a text
tools.description: Send one SMS to one or more numbers. This sends real messages to real phones and cannot be undone. The customer must hold explicit written consent from every recipient before you use this tool (Clearstream terms, section 4G). Opted-out numbers are skipped (for a list of numbers) or cause an error (for one number). Clearstream API: POST /v1/texts.

anyOf.description: Mobile number, preferably E.164 format, for example +12005551000.

items.description: Mobile number, preferably E.164 format, for example +12005551000.

anyOf.description: Mobile numbers in E.164 format (1-100 per call).

to.description: One mobile number, or an array of up to 100 numbers.

text_body.description: The message text. Header and body together must fit the character limit.

text_header.description: Sender name shown before the text, for example the organization name. GSM 7-bit characters only.

from.description: A sending number from clearstream_list_numbers (default: the account shortcode).

use_default_header.description: Use the account default header instead of text_header.

media_url.description: Optional JPG or PNG image URL under 5 MB (MMS must be enabled).

tools.name: clearstream_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add a subscriber
tools.description: Create or add one subscriber, with optional lists and tags. By default the subscriber must confirm opt-in by text. The customer must hold explicit written consent from every recipient before you use this tool (Clearstream terms, section 4G). Clearstream API: POST /v1/subscribers.

mobile_number.description: Mobile number, preferably E.164 format, for example +12005551000.

lists.description: List ids to add the subscriber to.

tags.description: Tag ids to add to the subscriber.

double_optin.description: Send a confirmation text before opt-in (default true).

tools.name: clearstream_add_subscriber_to_list
tools.title: Add a subscriber to a list
tools.description: Add one mobile number to a subscriber list. Locked lists cannot change. The customer must hold explicit written consent from every recipient before you use this tool (Clearstream terms, section 4G). Clearstream API: POST /v1/lists/{id}/subscribers.

mobile_number.description: Mobile number, preferably E.164 format, for example +12005551000.

annotations.title: Add a subscriber to a list

tools.name: clearstream_remove_subscriber_from_list
tools.title: Remove a subscriber from a list
tools.description: Remove one mobile number from a subscriber list. The subscriber's opt-in status does not change. Locked lists cannot change. Clearstream API: DELETE /v1/lists/{id}/subscribers/{number}.

mobile_number.description: Mobile number in E.164 format, for example +12005551000.

annotations.title: Remove a subscriber from a list

tools.name: clearstream_tag_subscribers
tools.title: Tag subscribers
tools.description: Add a tag to up to 100 subscribers by mobile number. The customer must hold explicit written consent from every recipient before you use this tool (Clearstream terms, section 4G). Clearstream API: POST /v1/tags/{id}/subscribers.

items.description: Mobile number, preferably E.164 format, for example +12005551000.

mobile_numbers.description: Mobile numbers in E.164 format (1-100 per call).
